text: player
Is this the place?
Just as I'm about to push open the door...
Male Voice
Ahhhh!
Whoa!
With a shriek, someone comes rushing out of the teahouse and nearly collides with me.
Careful, friend!
Whew... Thanks. Huh? Yuan Feng?
Yuan Feng

I look with trepidation at the brawny man who just came rushing out. With his upside-down triangle figure, he looks like a small walking mountain, and his fists look as big as stoneware bowls as he gesticulates and shouts. I might as well have nearly been hit by a dump truck!
What's going on h--
Youth A
Ahhhh!
Youth B
Aieeee!
Brawny Man
Right, m-my plan. Anyway, j-j-just you wait, miss!
Girl in Qipao
Yuan Xiao
Yuan Xiao places her hands on her hips with a resigned sigh.
Bamboo Cloud, huh...
Fuuka Minami
I'm afraid that I'm here representing Bamboo Cloud. Here's my card.
Huh?!
Yuan Xiao glances at my card before solemnly returning it to me.
Why?
What do you mean by "why?" The boss made a point of saying we wouldn't be working with Bamboo Cloud before he took off. And what the boss says, goes.
Fair enough... but--
It's a scorcher out here today. Why don't we continue this conversation inside over some tea?
Miss Yuan, would you please find us a quiet place to sit and recommend some tea for my friend here to try?
Hmm... If it's just for tea, then fine. Right this way.
I barely take two steps following Yuan Xiao when she stops, spins around, and gives me a sharp look, firmly repeating her earlier point.
H-Hahaha...
Sigh... What my boss says, goes too. Now what do I do...?
After taking a seat and watching as Yuan Xiao leaves to prepare the tea, I slump down in my chair.
My friend, I've just read your fortune. Care to hear it?
Yes, please!
This business matter of yours is going to look up... perhaps very soon.
Haha, patience! Enjoy your tea and take it as it comes. If I speak too plainly, it could influence your behavior and backfire on you.
Here you go! Enjoy!
A moment later
The smooth green tea in the glass cup
The bright amber tea in the white porcelain cup
Hehe, this is our "Mountain Mist" tea. It's our top seller!
You're a natural tea connoisseur, my friend.
Try another one
Abstain for now
Middle-aged Man
Anyone in?
I'm sorry, he went out to take care of something. How can I help?
Young Male
You must be joking. This is above your paygrade, little girl. Now get that rascal Fei Ming out here!
More troublemakers?
Mr. Li
Young Female
You're telling me you checked each and every one? If not, how can you be so certain that there weren't any bad ones?
A woman at the same table then stands up and nudges the plate of fruit in front of her. She speaks in a soft, gentle tone, but her words are less than friendly.
Everyone around here calls her "San Niang." If you're thinking of getting on her bad side, I'd advise against it. Even Ms. Minami treads carefully around her.
Why would I want to get on her bad side?
What...?
Hmph. You think giving this green tea a pretentious name elevates it somehow? You gotta be kidding. Nothing ticks me off more than snobbery.
Mr. Zhao, he runs the Meridian Scholar tea house not far from here. Despite his bad temper, business is actually quite good for him.
Do tea drinkers... prefer stronger flavors nowadays?
Haha, not at all. It's mainly because the tea house has a nice name, as well as good feng shui. Multiple people have won the lottery when drinking tea near his tea house--
My tea doesn't taste so good all of a sudden...
Mr. Zhao
Bringing up the tea my boss drinks all of a sudden? That's interesting.
Yeah, right... Uh, I mean, do you think it's true?
No, no need.
I... It's not that I'm holding out on you, it's just that I genuinely don't know which tea Ms. Minami had that day.
Y-You... Hrgh! {var:Shake}
Get up and intervene
Sit tight and observe
To my surprise, Yuan Feng gives me a pat on the arm.
This is your chance.
Huh? What?
From your divination. Go and seize it.
Why?
Realizing this opportunity, I promptly rise to my feet.
Let's all calm down and talk this over.
And just who might you be?
Ahem, um, I represent Bamboo Cloud.
So, you're the blasted source of our problems!
San Niang
Having kept silent until now, San Niang stands up. She reaches out and tugs at Mr. Zhao, then smiles and passes me a red envelope.
The real reason we came here was to deliver this.
An invitation... to a "tea competition?"
But that doesn't mean we have to compete with any of you.
San Niang's gaze circles back to Yuan Xiao and I before landing squarely on Yuan Feng. Yuan Feng, however, maintains an air of indifference.
Haha, a bit of friendly competition, that's all. Hahaha.
Easier said than done. And if we lose?
Tea Drinker A
Tea Drinker B
What? There's gonna be a tea competition?
Tea Drinker C
Tea Drinker D
Everyone, our friend here from Bamboo Cloud and Miss Yuan Xiao are simply acting on their bosses' orders. Only their respective employers can agree to this, wouldn't you agree?
This guy isn't as blind to the situation as he seems...
(whisper) Zhao, not everyone who wears sunglasses is blind.
That was a bit uncalled for, Mr. Zhao. Why don't you propose a time, and these two can discuss it with their superiors?
After casting Yuan Feng an appreciative glance, Yuan Xiao and I shuffle off to separate corners.
But... who should I contact?
The omnipotent manager Ume
Ume
Just go along with what the tea association wants.
I'll just tell them we can't... Wait, what?
This is a good thing. All you have to do is wait and see.
But...
"Beep... Beep... Beep..." And with that, the call is callously ended...
Thinking back on San Niang's conduct, that does seem true...
Ms. Minami, did you...?
Sorry, I forgot what I was going to say. Please, continue.
Honestly, I sacrifice too much for this job...
Having received the go-ahead from my superior, I gather my thoughts, go back over to the tea association members and exchange glances with Yuan Xiao, who has already returned.
Yuan Feng, do some divination, quickly--I think Yuan Xiao's been possessed...
Rubber-necking and gossiping are in humanity's nature, and the tea drinkers are no different as they begin discussing the competition. Among them, however, are a few dissenting voices...
Loyal Tea Drinker A
How could Fei Ming of all people accept a competition like this?
Loyal Tea Drinker B
Loyal Tea Drinker C
Honestly... Fei Ming's thought process is as opaque as the steam from this tea.
Before I can hear any more gossip about Fei Ming, Yuan Xiao has served the "guests" from the tea association and rushes over to shake my hand.
So, your skills have already reached that level...
I think about what my boss said to me earlier.
Of course, I'll be there.
I wouldn't miss it.

I look up at the old, three-story building in front of me. An unassuming plaque hanging above the door frame reads "Magical Dream." The handwriting might be from some famous person. The brush strokes are disjointed, yet the meaning flows with grace and grandeur.
The Twelve Astrological Stars are in "Minor Loss" today, meaning that minor mishaps are unavoidable. Take care out there today, my friend.
It would have been more than a "minor mishap" if it weren't for you.
Before I can ask Yuan Feng about the situation, two more figures fly out from the door with a "whoosh"--and that's no exaggeration!
That's what you get for thinking you can throw your weight around in Magical Dream.

A girl of about 16 or 17 wearing a qipao comes out the door, twirling her wrists. My gaze drifts from her clenched fists to the faces of the three people opposite her. Hm... they're all the same shape and size.
D-Don't be so cocky, you cow! We're getting our boss over here, then you'll really be sorry!
(whisper) But boss, aren't you the boss?
...Shut up!
(whisper) Idiot, this is all part of the boss's plan! Right, boss?
Ooh, aren't you the gentleman now! I thought I was a "cow?"
Wow... Nothing like intimidation to make people mind their manners.
Oh, a customer! Sorry you had to see that. Oh? Here for some tea as well, Mr. Yuan? Are you two here together?
Yes and no. Allow me to introduce you. This is {var:player_nickname}, my best--and I mean best--friend in One Han City.
This is Miss Yuan Xiao, Magical Dream's server... and, uh, part-time security guard?
Sigh.... the boss isn't even paying me extra for that.

This is the third time today, in fact. The boss left this morning saying that if there were any troublemakers, I could show them the door. I wasn't sure what he was talking about then, but now... Sigh--I've been so hard at work.
Evidently. Speaking of trouble, what brought those guys here?
Sigh... It all started when Bamboo Cloud announced out of nowhere that we'd be partnering with them for this year's anniversary celebration. Things have been crazy here ever since.
I've chosen Magical Dream as our tea supplier for this year's banquet. Go and discuss the details with them on my behalf.
I'm confident that you'll reach a satisfactory arrangement with them, hm?
Cutting straight to the chase?
Mr. Yuan is one of our regulars here, so as his friend, you may come in for tea. However, we will not be discussing any partnership.
Cutting me off, Yuan Feng suddenly folds his fan and pats my shoulder with a chuckle. I shoot him a questioning look, to which he almost indiscernibly shakes his head.
Tea only, no business!
...Could you be a little more specific?
I'm not sure what kind of tea you prefer. These are all Magical Dream's top teas, which would you like to try?
Yuan Xiao sets a tray down before me on the table. There are three cups of tea on it.
The light pink tea with petals floating in it in the covered cup
The elegant flavor fills my nostrils as the refreshingly sweet tea spreads over my tastebuds.
Wow...
You have a discerning eye, my friend. You only get this flavor by de-enzyming, twisting, and drying the first leaf shoots of spring.
The rich, sweet flavor fills my nostrils as the fragrant rose tea spreads over my tastebuds.
Wow...
Hehe, this is our "Petals in Mountain Stream" tea. It's made using high-quality black tea as a base, giving it that perfect level of sweetness!
Forget Champion Street--You won't find rose tea of this quality anywhere else in One Han City.

It requires an especially tedious process to make. You have to process the tea base, scent it with fresh flowers, remove the flowers and re-boil the tea, re-scent the tea, then store it until the flavor is just right... Thankfully, everyone who drinks it says it's good.
The pungent scent of agarwood fills my nostrils as the sweet, mellow tea spreads over my tastebuds.
Wow...
Hehe, this one's called "Moon of Yonder Mountain." It's the highest quality of these three teas.

This type of golden oolong tea, called "Gold Goddess of Mercy," is harvested, sun-withered, indoor-withered, tossed, and dried to bring out this full-bodied flavor. They say you can steep it multiple times without losing the flavor.
Just when I'm feeling like my stomach and tea knowledge have almost been filled to the brim, a ruckus seems to erupt in the tea house. Yuan Xiao excuses herself and rushes over to the source.
Is Fei Ming here?
I'm afraid these aren't your run-of-the-mill troublemakers. See the one in front? The middle-aged man who looks like he's smiling?
That's Mr. Li, he runs the New Moon tea house. He's also the head honcho of the tea association on Champion Street. As Bamboo Cloud's representative, you should be familiar with him.
New Moon... Is that the one that was recently renovated?
The materials Ume sent me did indeed mention this man. After all, he's been Bamboo Cloud's primary tea supplier for the last few years.

Supposedly, they only closed down for renovations so that they could work with Bamboo Cloud again this year, and now that's all gone. The partnership is over, the customers have left, and all that's left in the tea house is formaldehyde. It's been a bad year for them.
I'm sure we can work this out amicably if you just tell me what you need.
I finally came to Magical Dream for some tea and snacks to see what all the fuss has been about, but... even your fruits are rotten. You call that quality control?
I checked them myself when I served them, and they were fine!

This one's an even greater contender. She's the tea association's second-in-command and is reportedly its mastermind behind the scenes. She's more of a tactician than a businesswoman, but she keeps the entire business in order.
Yuan Feng says nothing, but smiles at me knowingly. I've got a bad feeling about this.
Who's the curmudgeon?
...It is this year's superfine tea, yes! How can you know it's bad without even tasting it?!
What do you know about tea? Think you can pull the wool over our eyes? Are you trying to tarnish the good name of Champion Street's tea houses by serving us this swill?!
Relax, Zhao. We're not trying to make things difficult for you, miss. Why don't you bring out your top-shelf stuff for us--the one you recently served to Ms. Minami.

Champion Street has been abuzz these last few days with a rumor that Ms. Minami suddenly decided to offer Magical Dream a major collaboration deal after drinking only a single cup of a mysterious tea here...
You represent Bamboo Cloud, don't you? How should I know! Haha. Shall I find out with some divination?

Fuuka Minami certainly never mentioned this to me, though I'm not sure whether that's because she forgot or didn't think it was important... Either way, who knows what's on her mind anyway? It is what it is, so I'd better get to work.
Sounds to me like there was no tea, but rather some sort of backroom deal!
Seeing that Yuan Xiao has taken a fighting stance and that the situation is about to get out of hand, as Bamboo Cloud's representative, I...
This all started because of Bamboo Cloud's decision. As the responsible party here, I should help our prospective partner, Magical Dream.
As Bamboo Cloud's representative, picking a side could get us into trouble. I should stay quiet and see how Magical Dream handles the situation.
If you let Magical Dream owe you a favor, wouldn't that open the door to negotiations?
Mr. Zhao, don't tell me you've forgotten what the feng shui master said when you had your tea house's feng shui assessed? Good karma starts with the words you speak.
Standing next to me with a smile, Yuan Feng uses his fan to shield me from the clear liquid spraying at me like a shower from Mr. Zhao. He then tosses the fan nonchalantly onto the table.
Looks like he won't be wanting it anymore.
I'm guessing you didn't come here just to torment a young lady. This must be about something else, surely?
My apologies. Zhao here can be rather blunt, I hope you won't take any offense.
As Mr. Yuan said, we didn't come to pick a fight, but rather to forge a friendship with Magical Dream by way of a tea competition.

In all these years, Magical Dream has never partnered with any other tea houses on Champion Street, nor has it joined the tea association. For it to suddenly attract Bamboo Cloud's attention, it must be exceptional indeed.
You're mistaken, my dear. The truth lies not in any quarrel between us, but in people's hearts.
All of a sudden, Magical Dream has seized the biggest order on Champion Street. Aren't you afraid you'll face a lifetime of criticism if you can't convince the rest of us that you've earned it?
So... we devised a foolproof plan--for Bamboo Cloud's old supplier, New Moon, to engage in a tea competition with Magical Dream.
Should Magical Dream win, it will naturally quash discontent on Champion Street regarding Bamboo Cloud's choice, as well as put a stop to the rumors encircling Magical Dream.
Should Magical Dream lose or back down from the challenge, then... Deary me.
San Niang covers her smile with her hand and says nothing further. Instead, it's the onlookers drawn to our dispute who begin to murmur amongst themselves.
That would mean that New Moon's right, and there's something fishy about the deal with Magical Dream.
And it'll be between New Moon and Magical Dream?
Ohoho, time to start placing bets!
One after another, the surrounding tea drinkers join in the commotion.
(whisper) I... The boss just said to deal with any trouble that comes in. He didn't say anything about a big scene like this...
Funny, my boss didn't say that anything like this was in the cards either...
That's acceptable.
This needs to go all the way to the top--Fuuka Minami!
I don't think I can bother the boss with something like this. I'd better ask Manager Ume what she thinks first. I apprehensively dial her number.
...Right, so basically, I came to discuss the partnership and now I have a tea competition on my hands!
But... what if Magical Dream loses?
I'd be more concerned about the report you'll be writing later if I were you.
Besides, you shouldn't underestimate Magical Dream. Only those with real talent can make it on Champion Street.
For other matters, contact customer service.
Now that I really think about it, Fuuka Minami was the one who should have come to discuss the partnership in the first place... I should take it up directly with her!
Upward management skills level up! Go me!
I apprehensively dial Fuuka Minami's number. When she answers, I give her the rundown of the situation...
Hehe... Nicely done. Your social skills far exceeded my expectations.
Social skills? More like the situation forced my hand!
I'm referring to Yuan Feng. Did you notice how polite the tea association was to him?

Rumor has it that Kazuha Saionji's retainer can divine the will of heaven. It was his heroic efforts that rescued Nishiha Dojo from the verge of ruin back then. But... hehe, apart from Kazuha Saionji, no one else can sway him.
Hehe, what was that?
But this works too. This way, you owe Yuan Feng a favor, but I don't owe Kazuha Saionji one. Next time I encounter her while playing mahjong, I don't worry about squaring up--I'll just go for it.

Come now! It just goes to show how capable you are. I'll give you an anniversary bonus. Besides, your social skills are a testament to your ability. I wouldn't have trusted you with such an important task otherwise.
As for the tea competition... the tea association has said their piece. All we have to do now is wait and see.
Huh? But what if Magical Dream loses?
Loses? Hehe... then that would mean that Mr. Fei Ming isn't worth his salt.
Anyway, I want you to watch this tea competition closely. After all, this will decide who Bamboo Cloud ultimately partners with.
Bamboo Cloud has expressed its support of the tea competition. We trust in Magical Dream's ability, but we will accept a more suitable partner should they emerge.
As for Magical Dream...
"If the moths insist on flying into flames, let them."
...I was just repeating my boss's words the way he said them!
Everyone hear that? Magical Dream has agreed to the tea competition! You can all bear witness when the time comes!

Seriously? Magical Dream's well-established, but they always carry the same stuff. New Moon, on the other hand--they have secret recipes for new teas that even tea experts haven't cracked yet. Magical Dream? More like a pipe dream.

Wow, you could really be onto something! Magical Dream has a third floor, and we have no idea what kind of teas they're concocting up there! Do you really think Fuuka Minami's tea came from the same menu as ours?
Tea is meant to clear your mind and ease your troubles. Wouldn't this competition undermine its original purpose by creating more conflict?
Thank you! Thank you! If you hadn't...
I'm sure you could have chucked them all out without any problem...
If you hadn't stopped me, er, helped me, Magical Dream might have had its first homicide!
Point is, I hope you'll come and watch tomorrow's competition! You too, Mr. Yuan! There's no way Magical Dream is losing to people like them!
Yuan Feng and I say our goodbyes and leave. I gaze at the setting sun and the silhouette of Magical Dream lit by the afterglow...
Sign, I thought I was just coming here today to exchange pleasantries, sign a contract, and finish work for the day. I never expected that my negotiation work here would only just be beginning...
